column5: The shared shell foundation centralizes tag and PID ownership, bounded process termination, persistent stock-MySQL result framing, PD leader observation, event correlation, diagnostics, and cleanup used by the existing Campaign 22 and 23 real-PD/TiKV proofs. Embedded self-tests cover zero and nonzero client-line accounting, exact row matching, tag ownership, endpoint parsing, and the absent-process cleanup path without starting TiUP. The broader RealTiKV test lifecycle, live-cluster regression after extraction, SQL semantics, plan evidence, failpoint setup, and general store/domain behavior remain open and scenario-owned.
